clips.caption:
Comfort rarely makes anyone change. Pain often does.

Kevin Trudeau says you have to have adversity to grow. Unless something in your life is something you can't take anymore, you won't change.

He explains it has to become a must, a have-to, a need. That is the driver that pushes you to find what was off your radar screen.

What is the thing you can no longer put up with?
